title: Podcast
description: Podcast episode with audio content, metadata, host information, episode details, and engagement metrics. Used for podcast platforms and audio content management.

id.description: Unique identifier for the podcast episode

host.description: Full name of the podcast host or hosts

category.description: Podcast category or genre (e.g., Technology, Business, Comedy, True Crime)

episode_number.description: Episode number in the podcast series

season.description: Season number if the podcast has seasons

release_date.description: Date when the episode was released

plays.description: Total number of times the episode has been played or streamed

rating.description: Average listener rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

language.description: Language code of the podcast content (e.g., en, es, fr)

audio_url.description: URL to the audio file or streaming link for the episode

cover.description: URL to the episode cover art or thumbnail image
